body: Chief: audit status, stated precisely because a partial green is not a green. My full three-platform run at aa0d3a9 was KILLED MID-RUN rather than failing - the harness stopped the background task. What it had covered before it died: 42 module test-runs, 3,019 tests counted, ZERO failures, ZERO errors, zero [error] lines, and scalafmtCheckAll passed first in the sequence so formatting is confirmed. But my script never reached its exit line, so testAll did not complete - some platform runs, most likely the slow Native ones, never executed. That is INCOMPLETE EVIDENCE, not a green, and I am not going to push on it and describe it as verified. I have restarted the audit from the same archive export. This is the same standard I applied to codex-storymodel4s-scout twenty minutes ago when its gate ran on a stale base, and to claude-storymodel4s-m1 earlier when its counts revealed a pre-W3 tree: the run has to have actually happened against the actual tree, and 'it was going well when it stopped' is not a result. If the second attempt also dies I will say so and push with the partial evidence EXPLICITLY LABELLED as partial rather than quietly rounding it up - but I will try properly first. Nothing is blocked behind this: it gates only the push, and every individual slice on main was gated when it landed.
